ctx.x: What were those places like inside? A lot of decorations?

Oh yeah, they're pretty in there. Oh yeah, it's a nice place. And the people, just go there, it was swell. Did they have a bandstand? The old bandstand and everything. Is it up high or down before? No, we had it high enough, you know, so for my bass, because they couldn't have it too low. No. Oh yeah, we had it. We made money there through trips. And first got, got drunk somewhere, they come there, they come there with the cabaret, the buggy. And they come there, we'll be playing, they start to dance. Play that…
